findings: Vulkan is the FASTER backend on Strix Halo: llama Vulkan AR 62.65 vs HIP 51.38 (+22%); Vulkan MTP 84.6 vs HIP 75.4.
hipEngine HIP kernels BEAT llama HIP kernels on AR (54.95 vs 51.38) - hipEngine HIP impl is good.
llama Vulkan AR (62.65) beats hipEngine best-HIP (54.95) by ~14%; Vulkan MTP (84.6) >> hipEngine (60.8).

The MTP gap decomposes into BACKEND (ROCm/HIP vs Vulkan shader compiler/driver efficiency on this iGPU) + MTP UPLIFT (verify amortization). hipEngine is HIP-only -> structurally on the disadvantaged backend.
implication: A large part of the gap is the ROCm-vs-Vulkan backend, separate from the MTP algorithm. Closing needs either a hipEngine Vulkan backend or raising HIP GEMV efficiency toward Vulkan; plus the vec-rowtile verify amortization for the uplift component.
